deep.title: Improving GPT‑5.6 Sol in ChatGPT—and expanding access to GPT-5.6 Luna for free users
deep.summary: ChatGPT introduces improved GPT-5.6 Sol with better accuracy and consistency, plus expanded access for free users and unlimited everyday chats with GPT-5.6 Luna.
deep.score_reason: GPT-5.6 Sol/Luna 是 OpenAI 旗舰模型中期迭代，Sol 改进准确性和一致性，Luna 向免费用户开放，对应用选型有参考价值，按旗舰中期迭代给 7 分。
deep.analysis:
这是一则来自 OpenAI 官方的产品更新公告，核心是 ChatGPT 对 GPT-5.6 Sol 模型做了性能提升，同时将 GPT-5.6 Luna 模型向免费用户开放了更多使用权限。

此前，大型语言模型在实际对话应用中面临两个典型痛点。一是模型在长对话或复杂任务中容易出现“前后不一致”的问题，比如同一问题换种问法就给出矛盾答案，或者在处理多步推理时中途偏离逻辑主线。二是高性能模型往往被限制在付费墙之后，免费用户只能使用能力明显缩水的版本，导致产品体验断层，也限制了模型在真实场景中收集反馈数据的广度。这次更新正是针对这两点做出的调整。

从技术流程来看，公告明确提到了两个改进方向。第一是“更好的准确性与一致性”，这通常意味着在模型对齐和推理链路层面做了优化。虽然公告没有展开具体技术细节，但结合行业实践，提升一致性往往涉及强化学习人类反馈流程的迭代，让模型在生成回复时更稳定地遵循指令和事实逻辑，减少自相矛盾。第二是扩大了 GPT-5.6 Luna 的访问范围，免费用户现在可以“无限日常聊天”。这里的“日常聊天”是一个重要的产品限定，暗示可能通过动态路由或资源分配策略，将高并发、低复杂度的对话场景分配给 Luna 处理，从而在控制推理成本的同时扩大服务覆盖面。这种分层服务架构本身就是一个工程亮点，它要求模型在保持响应质量的前提下，做到对用户几乎无感知的切换。

对 AI 应用岗的面试而言，这条资讯至少有三个可深入讨论的方向。第一，你可以借此展示对“模型一致性”问题的理解，说明在构建 AI 产品时，准确率只是一个维度，跨轮次、跨表述的稳定性才是决定用户信任的关键指标，面试中可以主动询问对方如何处理长对话中的状态漂移。第二，免费用户大规模接入高性能模型，背后是推理成本与用户体验的平衡，这涉及到模型量化、投机解码、请求调度等工程优化手段，是展示你工程化思维的好切入点。第三，从产品策略角度，将模型能力下放给免费用户，本质是在用规模换数据飞轮，你可以讨论这种策略如何影响模型后续的迭代方向，以及在实际业务中如何设计免费与付费功能的边界，让模型能力释放的同时不损害商业转化。这些都是大厂面试官在考察 AI 应用落地能力时非常看重的实战视角。

deep.title: Deep Agents vs LangChain vs LangGraph
deep.summary: Deep Agents, LangChain, and LangGraph each offer distinct approaches to building agents. In this post, we cover the key distinctions between our open source frameworks and when you should reach for each one.
deep.score_reason: LangChain官方对比三种agent框架选型，对工程选型决策有直接指导价值
deep.analysis:
在 AI 应用开发领域，LangChain 团队近期发布了一篇技术定位文章，系统梳理了旗下三个开源框架——Deep Agents、LangChain 和 LangGraph——在构建智能代理时的核心差异与适用场景。这不是一篇功能对比清单，而是一份面向开发者的选型指南，帮助团队根据任务复杂度、控制粒度和生产需求做出决策。

此前，开发者在构建 AI 代理时面临一个普遍痛点：框架要么过于高层导致灵活性不足，要么过于底层导致开发效率低下。LangChain 作为早期框架，提供了丰富的预置链和工具集成，但面对需要精细控制流程、处理复杂状态管理的场景时显得力不从心。LangGraph 的出现解决了这一问题，它让开发者能显式定义代理的决策图和状态流转，但学习曲线更陡。而当任务本身极其复杂、需要多代理协作或大规模并行时，这两个框架的抽象层次又显得不够用。开发者不得不在“快速上手”和“深度可控”之间反复权衡，缺乏一个从简单到复杂、从原型到生产的连贯工具链。

这篇文章的核心在于明确了三者的技术定位分层。LangChain 被定位为“入门级”框架，适合构建简单的单代理应用，比如一个能调用搜索工具、回答用户问题的聊天机器人。它的优势在于预置组件丰富，开发者用少量代码就能串联起 LLM 调用、工具使用和记忆管理。LangGraph 则面向需要“可控认知架构”的场景，底层基于有向图模型，允许开发者精确控制代理的每一步推理、工具调用和状态更新。它特别适合那些执行路径不固定、需要根据中间结果动态调整策略的任务，比如多步研究、代码生成与调试。Deep Agents 是三者中最新的框架，定位为“生产级复杂代理系统”的构建工具。它解决的是当单个代理无法完成任务时，如何将任务规划、分解、分配给多个专业化子代理，并协调它们并行工作的问题。其技术要点在于内置了任务规划器、子代理调度机制和结果合成能力，开发者不需要从零实现多代理编排逻辑。

对于准备 AI 应用岗面试的工程师来说，这条资讯有几点值得深入准备。第一，它反映了大厂对 AI 应用工程化的核心诉求：从“能跑通 demo”到“生产可维护”。面试中如果被问到“你如何选择代理框架”，可以依据任务复杂度来回答——简单线性任务用 LangChain 快速验证，需要精确控制推理流程用 LangGraph，涉及多代理协作或复杂任务分解则考虑 Deep Agents。第二，LangGraph 的“认知架构”概念是一个很好的技术深度展示点，可以结合其图模型讲清楚如何实现可观测、可中断、可恢复的代理执行流程，这正是生产环境的基本要求。第三，Deep Agents 背后的设计思想——任务规划与子代理调度——与业界热议的“多代理系统”“Agent 编排”直接相关，可以延伸到如何设计代理间的通信协议、如何处理子任务失败重试、如何合并并行结果等工程问题。最后，注意这三个框架同属 LangChain 生态，这意味着在实际项目中可以根据模块复杂度混合使用，而不是非此即彼，这种务实的技术选型思路本身就是一个加分回答。

deep.title: ABSeeker: Training Long-Horizon Search Agents via Answer-Backtracked Credit Assignment
deep.summary: Long-horizon search agents must make multiple sequential actions (steps) to search, retrieve, verify, and integrate evidence to reach a final answer. However, existing methods for training these agents typically treat all steps within a trajectory uniformly during both supervised fine-tuning (SFT) and reinforcement learning (RL), failing to distinguish useful actions from erroneous or redundant ones. In this paper, we propose Answer-Backtracked Credit Assignment (ABC), a fine-grained credit assignment framework for training long-horizon search agents by converting sparse trajectory-level outcomes into dense step-level supervision that rewards useful actions (even in failed trajectories) while suppressing erroneous or redundant actions. Specifically, given a potentially obscure query and its corresponding ground-truth answer, ABC first performs Answer-Backtracked Clue Recovery, which traces back from the answer to recover intermediate clues required to solve the question. It then applies Clue-Anchored Step Scoring to evaluate each search step against these clues, converting sparse binary outcome supervision into dense step-level rewards. Based on these rewards, we develop ABC-SFT, which reweights the loss of each turn, and ABC-GRPO, which uses the step-level scores as rewards in GRPO. Building on this framework, we train ABSeeker based on Qwen3.5-4B with only 8.5k examples. ABSeeker achieves 37.3% on BrowseComp and 39.1% on BrowseComp-ZH. With context management, the scores fu
deep.score_reason: upvotes 55 高热度，提出基于答案回溯的信用分配方法训练长 horizon 搜索 agent，对 agent 训练方法论有实质贡献。
deep.analysis:
Long-horizon search agents（长程搜索智能体，指需要多步搜索、检索、验证、整合信息才能回答复杂问题的 AI 系统）的训练一直面临一个核心难题：如何判断一次多步搜索轨迹中，哪些步骤真正有用、哪些是冗余甚至错误的。ABSeeker 提出了一种名为 Answer-Backtracked Credit Assignment（ABC，答案回溯式功劳分配）的细粒度功劳分配框架，专门用于训练这类需要长程推理的搜索智能体。

此前的训练方法，无论是监督微调还是强化学习，通常将整个搜索轨迹中的所有步骤一视同仁——要么整条轨迹成功就全部奖励，要么失败就全部惩罚。这种粗粒度的反馈方式无法区分有效动作和无效动作，导致模型在失败轨迹中无法学到哪些步骤其实做对了，在成功轨迹中也无法识别哪些步骤是多余的。更严重的是，稀疏的轨迹级反馈使得长程搜索任务中的信用分配极为困难，模型难以建立步骤级别的因果推理能力。

ABC 框架的核心思路是将稀疏的轨迹级结果转化为密集的步骤级监督信号。它分两步实现：第一步是 Answer-Backtracked Clue Recovery（答案回溯式线索恢复），即给定一个可能模糊的查询和对应的标准答案，从答案反向追溯，恢复出解决该问题所需的关键中间线索。通俗理解，就是先搞清楚“要得到这个答案，中间必须经过哪些信息节点”。第二步是 Clue-Anchored Step Scoring（线索锚定式步骤评分），将搜索过程中的每一步与恢复出的线索进行比对，评估每一步对最终答案的贡献度，从而将原本二元的成功/失败标签转化为每个步骤的连续评分。基于这些步骤级评分，研究者开发了两种训练变体：ABC-SFT 在监督微调阶段根据步骤评分重新加权每个轮次的损失，让模型更关注高贡献步骤；ABC-GRPO 则在强化学习中将步骤评分直接作为奖励信号，引导策略优化。

对 AI 应用岗而言，ABSeeker 的工程价值体现在几个关键点。首先是数据效率极高：仅用 8.5k 训练样本，基于 Qwen3.5-4B 模型就达到了 BrowseComp 37.3% 和 BrowseComp-ZH 39.1% 的成绩，配合上下文管理后分数进一步提升。这意味着在真实业务场景中，可以用极少的标注数据训练出可用的长程搜索智能体，大幅降低数据采集和标注成本。其次是生产可用性：ABC 框架天然适合处理“部分正确”的中间状态，这在客服、研究助手、自动化报告生成等需要多步信息检索的场景中至关重要——系统可以在用户中途干预或部分失败时仍给出有价值的反馈，而不是全盘否定。面试中可谈的点包括：如何将稀疏奖励转化为密集奖励的通用方法论、步骤级信用分配与过程奖励模型的异同、以及如何在低资源场景下通过答案回溯构建训练信号。这些都是当前大模型应用落地中非常实际的问题。

mid.title: Resume Means Resume: A Machine-Checked Conformance Contract for Checkpoint, Interrupt, and Resume Semantics in Workflow Persistence Layers
mid.summary: A framework that persists execution state so a run can be interrupted, survive a crash, and continue must decide what a resume means for effects that already fired. Five widely deployed agent workflow frameworks answer differently, none exposes a machine-checkable contract, and behavior violates even the fragments they state. The RESUME CONTRACT states six properties over the persistence API (prefix continuation, effect exactly-once, fork determinism, checkpoint validity, consume-once, recovery determinism), plus fork-intent and liveness obligations. A TLA+ model checks a reference semantics exhaustively, unchanged at scaled bounds (7.4 million states); a 39-cell fault matrix yields the separating models independence requires, and consume-once splits, its consumption clause independent of all six others. A deterministic, LLM-free harness measures them at pinned releases. LangGraph 1.2.9 durably records a second resume value and never consults it, persists schema-invalid state silently, and re-executes durably recorded work after a real SIGKILL: exactly-once across interrupts, at-least-once across crashes, on one API. CrewAI 1.15.2 re-executes completed effect-bearing methods against its written claim; pydantic-graph 1.x cannot resume after a mid-node crash; no two probed frameworks share a conformance profile. Consume-once holds sequentially and fails under concurrent delivery: k processes resuming one parked interrupt fire the gated effect k times, saturation 1.0 in 36 of 40
mid.score_reason: 直接分析 5 个主流 agent 工作流框架的持久化语义问题，提出可验证契约，对生产级 agent 工程有重要参考价值。
mid.analysis: 这是一个关于工作流持久层中断与恢复语义的研究框架。它提出了“RESUME CONTRACT”，定义了六项机器可验证的属性，包括前缀延续、副作用精确一次执行和分叉确定性等，以规范检查点、中断和恢复行为。研究发现，包括LangGraph和CrewAI在内的五种主流智能体工作流框架，其实际行为均与自身声明不符，且没有两个框架共享相同的合规性配置。该工作通过TLA+模型在740万状态空间内进行了穷尽检查，并揭示了在并发恢复场景下“消费一次”属性会饱和失效。这值得关注，因为它首次为工作流恢复提供了可机器检查的一致性契约，并暴露了当前框架在崩溃恢复语义上的普遍缺陷。

model.title: K-EXAONE 2.0 Technical Report
model.summary: This technical report presents K-EXAONE 2.0, an open-weight multilingual foundation model developed by LG AI Research as a step in our effort toward global frontier-scale foundation models. Rather than training from scratch, we upcycle K-EXAONE and expand its architecture, yielding a Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) model with 750B total parameters and approximately 37B activated per token---more than three times the capacity of its predecessor. K-EXAONE 2.0 supports context lengths of up to 256K tokens and expands multilingual coverage from six to ten languages. Its training pipeline combines continual pre-training, difficulty-focused mid-training, and post-training to strengthen reasoning, agentic coding, multilingual capability, and safety grounded in Korean sociocultural contexts. Across nine evaluation categories selected to reflect the conditions of practical use, K-EXAONE 2.0 improves over K-EXAONE and remains competitive with open-weight models, showing its largest gains in agentic coding and long-context understanding and its clearest strengths in long-context retrieval and safety. Released under the Apache 2.0 license, K-EXAONE 2.0 enables the wider AI ecosystem to evaluate, deploy, adapt, and build upon it, while marking the beginning---rather than the endpoint---of our challenge toward the global frontier.

paper.title: OneDayAgent: Towards a Long-Horizon Harness for Autonomous Agents
paper.summary: LLM agents are increasingly applied to open-ended everyday requests that span work, study, and life. These tasks are long-horizon, cross-environment, and multimodal, forcing the agent to preserve goals and constraints across many steps while navigating heterogeneous tools and attachments. While prior work has addressed individual failure modes such as goals drift, states loss, and context overflow, whether a single harness can manage them jointly and remain effective across backends has received less study. We present OneDayAgent, a long-horizon harness for autonomous agents. OneDayAgent turns an open-ended request into a managed execution process that decomposes tasks into bounded subtasks, maintains execution memory under context pressure, and verifies and repairs the final deliverable. We evaluate OneDayAgent on AgentIF-OneDay across 104 tasks. With the GLM-5.2 backend, OneDayAgent sets a new state of the art with an overall score of 0.821. The same harness runs across five backend LLMs from three model families, indicating the harness generalizes across backends without tuning, even as different models induce distinct execution styles under the same workflow.
paper.score_reason: 长周期自主agent评测框架，upvotes高，直接面向agent工程中的目标漂移、状态丢失等生产问题

paper.title: Recursive Synthesis for Long-Horizon Terminal Tasks
paper.summary: High-quality long-horizon training data for terminal agents is expensive to produce, often costing hundreds to thousands of dollars per task, because each task must keep the instruction, environment, reference solution, and verifier mutually consistent. Human authoring does not scale, and direct generation with large language models (LLMs) often breaks these dependencies. We present Recursive Synthetic Terminal Tasks (RST), a recursive verified synthesis framework for constructing long-horizon terminal-agent tasks at scale. Starting from verified seed tasks, RST extends the reference solution, realigns the verifier and instruction to the new workflow, validates the result in a fresh sandbox, and reuses accepted tasks as seeds for subsequent rounds. Across fifteen recursive rounds, RST produces 37,484 synthesized terminal-agent tasks at roughly \0.05 per task. Task difficulty increases substantially over rounds: the median reference solution grows from 67 to 374 lines, the median number of executed commands grows from 40 to 244, and DeepSeek-V4-Pro pass@4 drops from 90% at R_1 to 2.5% at R_{15}$. To demonstrate training utility, we collect rejection-sampled Qwen3.5 trajectories on the synthesized tasks and use them for supervised fine-tuning. paper.title: Lossless Tensor Compression as Program Synthesis
paper.summary: Model checkpoints are growing in both number and size, which makes archival, transfer, and deployment increasingly costly. paper.title: DRIFT: Derailing Denoising Trajectories of Flow-Matching VLAs with Adversarial Patch Attack
paper.summary: Flow-matching vision-language-action (VLA) models such as pi0 generate robot actions by integrating a learned denoising velocity field, and have been reported to resist adversarial perturbations that readily fool autoregressive VLAs. We show that this robustness is largely illusory: it stems from prior attacks ignoring the multi-step denoising ODE. We introduce DRIFT (Denoising Redirection via Input perturbation of the Flow-matching Trajectory), a test-time universal adversarial patch placed on the robot's gripper that attacks the denoising velocity field of an off-the-shelf policy. Our central finding is counterintuitive: attacking only the first denoising step is both stronger and cheaper than attacking a wider window of steps, which we explain through a gradient conflict unique to input-space optimization and which is exactly opposite to the training-time backdoor regime. On pi0 and pi0.5 across four LIBERO suites, DRIFT breaks essentially all originally-solvable tasks with a small single patch, far exceeding action- and embedding-space attack baselines.

paper.title: AVE-Compass: Towards Holistic Evaluation for Audio-Video Editing Abilities
paper.summary: While instruction-based video editing has advanced rapidly, real-world videos contain tightly coupled audio and visual signals, and editing one modality often requires coordinated changes in the other. Existing benchmarks primarily evaluate visual transformations on silent clips or isolated audio editing, leaving complex audio-visual editing and cross-modal consistency underexplored. We introduce AVE-Compass, a comprehensive benchmark with 145 curated source videos, 196 audio-visually coupled editing instructions, and 2,688 fine-grained checklist items. It evaluates Instruction Following, Fidelity Preserving, Realism, and Editing Intent through checklist-based MLLM judging and a dedicated realism rubric, complemented by automated cross-modal, video, and audio metrics. Extensive evaluation shows that state-of-the-art models still struggle to execute cross-modal instructions while preserving non-target content. We further propose AVE-Agent, a modular agent framework that decomposes complex instructions into dependent subtasks and iteratively improves editing results through self-reflection and evaluator feedback. AVE-Agent improves instruction execution, Fidelity Preserving, and audio-visual alignment in joint editing while maintaining competitive perceptual quality.
